# Bo Shang

> Bo Shang is a robotics and AI researcher and a Postdoctoral Associate at the University of Maryland (Civil and Environmental Engineering / Maryland Transportation Institute). His work combines embodied field robots with fixed 3D sensing and auditable AI simulation for transportation and civil infrastructure: bridge-inspection robots, roadside LiDAR-camera perception, and geospatial AI.

This is his personal academic website. Contact: bshang@umd.edu. For one self-contained plain-Markdown profile, read [llms-full.txt](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/llms-full.txt).

- [Home](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/): Personal introduction, research across scales, current position, teaching, and selected publications

## Research

- [Publications](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/publications/): Full bibliography with DOI, PDF, and Google Scholar links
- [Systems portfolio](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/): Seven interactive showcases of built and deployed systems
- [BIRDS bridge inspection robot](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/portfolio-2/): Patented hybrid flying and girder-clamping robot (US patent 12,296,994)
- [PACO & roadside LiDAR safety auditing](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/paco-safety-auditing/): Intersection observability metric and near-miss auditing with roadside 3D LiDAR
- [Highway LiDAR + camera & InfraLiDAR-Eval](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/portfolio-1/): 61.9-hour I-95 roadside LiDAR benchmark
- [Concrete defect inspection](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/concrete-defect-inspection/): Robotic inspection and 3D localization of concrete defects (IEEE T-ASE 2025)
- [CERRA geospatial AI platform](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/cerra-platform/): Geospatial AI and LLM-SUMO traffic simulation platform at UMD
- [Fractional-order UAV visual servoing](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/uav-visual-servoing/): Flight control for GPS-denied quadrotor visual servoing
- [ScholarMind AI](https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/portfolio/scholarmind-ai/): Bilingual AI education and research platform
